representative_policy: Public full-coordinate examples are available for 2 of 2 assigned clusters. Trim-specific medoids, ensembles, TM grids and Bonsai are not available in these views.
mask_note: Clustering retains CDK2 A1–298 and DOC1 B60–115 (354 residues). DOC1 B1–59 is excluded from clustering. Coordinate downloads contain the original full construct.
clustering_method_note: UMAP KNN uses a fresh 2D mask-specific UMAP with KNN-connected Ward labels. Both cohorts were fit separately. The PCA variance refers to the masked distance sketch. Saved confidence, ProteinEBM and DockQ values describe their original full-construct scoring scope. The combined cohort includes 999 BioEMU2 frames flagged for failed physicality checks.

core_results.summary: Full → trimmed, HDBSCAN leaf: 51 → 57 clusters; 2,696 → 2,289 unassigned. 2/2 clusters in this view have a published structure example.
core_results.structures_note: Trim-specific medoids, aligned ensembles, TM grids and Bonsai are unavailable.
